scripts.api-codegen: cp ${RUNAI_REPO_PATH:-../../$REPO_NAME}/$SWAGGER_PATH src/modules/api/apis/$SERVICE_NAME/swagger.yaml; rm -rf src/modules/api/apis/$SERVICE_NAME/generated; docker run --rm -v ${PWD}:/local openapitools/openapi-generator-cli:v6.2.1 generate -i /local/src/modules/api/apis/$SERVICE_NAME/swagger.yaml -g typescript-node -t local/src/modules/api/apis/templates -o /local/src/modules/api/apis/$SERVICE_NAME/generated --additional-properties=supportsES6=true,npmVersion=6.9.0,typescriptThreePlus=true && cp src/modules/api/apis/templates/httpError.ts src/modules/api/apis/$SERVICE_NAME/generated/api/httpError.ts
scripts.api-codegen-all: npm run api-codegen-backendApi && npm run api-codegen-assetsApi && npm run api-codegen-projectsDepartmentsApi && npm run api-codegen-backendClusterApi && npm run api-codegen-tenantsManagerApi && npm run api-codegen-authorizationApi && npm run api-codegen-identityManagerApi && npm run api-codegen-datavolumesApi && npm run api-codegen-orgUnitApi
